info.title: Flingtopia implemented Release 1 baseline
info.description: Documents actual implemented behavior, not all planned Release 1 features. Cookies are HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production. Unsafe methods require exact Origin. Shared database /api limiter 180/min per IP; auth entry limiter 10/15min per IP; login 10/15min per normalized email; staff MFA 6/5min per account; photo uploads 6/15min per account. Some 404 and rate-limit errors omit request_id. Request schemas are generated from shared runtime Zod validation; unknown object properties are stripped. Recovery and onboarding are implemented; no payment, live or KYC endpoints are claimed.
